name: mousing
description: Live Lightning Lane return times, park crowd trends and seasonal hunts for Walt Disney World, on Cloudflare's free plan.

scripts.check:build: wrangler pages functions build --outdir .wrangler/ci/functions && cd src/cron && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.example.toml --outdir ../../.wrangler/ci/cron
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:pages && npm run check:build
scripts.baseline:load: cd src/cron && wrangler kv key put parks:baseline --path ../../data/park_baseline.json --binding KV --remote
